# NearBasket

> NearBasket is a local shopping marketplace for discovering nearby shops, browsing products and placing and tracking customer orders.

The marketplace supports location-based shop discovery, shopping carts, checkout, customer order history and delivery information.

## Product resources

- [Marketplace](https://hardikkatare10-ux.github.io/billpilot/consumer): Browse local shops and products.
- [NearBasket catalog](/nearbasket/ai-catalog.json): Machine-readable product catalog.
- [Project documentation](https://github.com/hardikkatare10-ux/billpilot): Source code and project information.
